references.title: SciPy lognorm and distribution fitting
references.decision: Fit only predeclared normal/lognormal marginals on training rows; fix lognormal location at zero; withhold unresolved support or scale.

references.title: SciPy rankdata
references.decision: Retain ties using average ranks and finite plotting positions; estimate latent normal-score correlation without reading holdout values.

references.title: Gneiting and Raftery (2007), Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation
references.decision: Independently implement the finite weighted energy-score loss using SciPy pairwise distances and caller-declared variable scales. No wording, figures, tables or software were copied.

references.title: Helwig, Pignanelli and Schuetze, Condition monitoring of hydraulic systems, DOI 10.24432/C5CW21
references.decision: Read all source cycles without treating profile labels as independent field trials or error opportunities; retain full condition and original source-order blocks.
